confirm_stop_charging: Are you sure to stop charging?
max_power_charging_mode_tip: The EV charger will charge the electric vehicle with max. power. The PV and ESS system will supply the EV charger firstly. IF not enough, the grid will supply the EV charger at the same time. If there is PV power, it will supply the EV charger and other loads firstly, and then charge the battery of ESS. At last it will feed into the grid. Max. EV charging power P_EVmax=Pmax
mode_conflict_tip: When there is a conflict of charging modes during the same time period, the system will execute the charging mode that the current EV-charger is running.
no_com_battery_ess_ev_charger: No communication between Battery ESS and EV Charger
no_enough_power: In this mode, now, power is not enough to start the charging pile
normal_charge_tip: The EV charger's power source is PV and batteries. If there is PV power, it will supply other loads firstly, then supply the EV charger and maximize the EV charging power, and then charge the battery of ESS. Lastly, it will feed into the grid. The battery will be used for other loads and for EV charger. Max. EV charging power is P_EVmax=P_pv-P_load+P_bat.
normal_chargeh4_tip: NOTE: if the on-board charger (OBC) on the electric vehicle is three-phase, in this mode, the EV charger may not be started by insufficient PV.
open_control_tip: For commissioning the system, installer or service company would be authorized to operate the EV charger by default. If you do not wish others to operate the EV charger, please turn off this function.
plug_once_play_tip: If this feature is enabled, it means that charging will start when the charging gun is inserted and stop when the gun is removed. If this feature is enabled, the charging functions such as web monitoring or APP charging on/off, and swipe card charging cannot be used. If this feature is disabled, it is not possible to start charging by inserting the gun or stop charging by removing the gun.
quick_charge_tip: The PV and battery power will first supply the EV charger. If PV power is available, it will supply the EV charger firstly, then supply other loads, and then charge the battery of ESS. Lastly, it will feed into the grid. The battery will be used for EV charger and then for other loads. Max. EV charging power is P_EVmax=P_pv+P_bat.
slow_charging_tip: The EV charger's power source is PV only. If there is PV power, it will supply other loads firstly, then charge the battery of ESS, and then supply the EV charger. Lastly, it will feed into the grid. The battery can be used for other loads, but not for EV charger. Max. EV charging power is P_EVmax=P_pv-P_load-P_bat
smart_mode_tip: If this mode is turned on and the green mode is selected and the OBC selection is three-phase, when the charging current available for each phase of the system's three-phase is less than 6A, the system will automatically switch the EV-charger to the single-phase OBC function mode to maximize the use of energy supplied to the EV-charger.
specify_charge_desc:
The EV charger will charge the electric vehicle with the specified power. The PV and ESS system will supply the EV charger firstly. IF not enough, the grid will supply the EV charger at the same time. This specified power value is set by the user below, the setting range is from 6A to 16A per phase, and the default value is the AC rated current value (16A per phase for SMILE-EVCT11)
If there is PV power, it will supply the EV charger and other loads firstly, and then charge the battery of ESS. At last it will feed into the grid.
Max. EV charging power P_EVmax=Pset
stop_charge_tip: After stopping charging, you must remove the charging gun to restart the timed charging strategy and mode of the EV-charger
